requestedIntent: Select model and reasoning effort by ACEF role while allowing equivalent runtimes from additional LLM providers to be mapped without changing lifecycle semantics. A provider may also name a model per role (roleModels) over its class mapping, and a run may override one role's model (active-run routingRoleModels); one shared resolver applies run override, then policy roleModels, then the class mapping. Review roles never go below the ACEF-owned floors (method/model-review-floors-v1.json, loaded apart from any host policy) without a recorded owner exemption, and consumers fail loudly when a host kept an older routing library.
limitations: The calibrated mapping is OpenAI-only (V327-CAL-001 on gpt-5.6-sol; the 2026-10-27 remap to gpt-6.1-sol is not recalibrated). The anthropic mapping (Sonnet for every class, with Patch Assurance and both Judges on Opus through roleModels; owner decision 2026-10-27) has no role-specific calibration evidence.

Pre-dispatch enforcement is versioned as admitted-role-routing-v1 on new Fix and Standard runs; existing in-flight runs retain their original contract. Native work remains outside ACEF model routing, while Full capsule-supervisor dispatch keeps its existing compiled enforcement.
V327-CAL-001 qualifies medium only for Code Review on one held-out authorization defect. It does not lower ATDD, Development, Patch Assurance, or Process Judge floors.

V3.28 exercised the complete role-routed matrix across four cycle-0 story PASS gates, typed Epic PASS, hard-budget PASS, and a zero-finding high-effort blind product PASS. Its immutable process row still failed on a repaired outer-scorer false negative, so the capability remains enforced rather than proven.
A provider the ACEF review floors do not cover (a host-added provider) is not floor-checked at the policy level; run overrides on its review roles need an exemption.

V3.27 also exposed that the external blind Judge inherited the conductor runtime. The successor harness now resolves it from the high terminal epic-process-judge profile, quarantines abandoned launch roots, and produced a valid high-effort FAIL judgment; no invalid medium judgment was persisted.
